d:
South Goa is unmissable! And in this video, I'm experiencing Goa with TATA Tiago EV!
And if you are planning a trip to this side of Goa, I’ve got you covered with all kinds of travel recommendations. From hikes, and cycle tours to the most beautiful and empty beaches and experiencing Goa in an EV!
We'll immerse ourselves in the hidden treasures of South Goa, all while cruising in the eco-friendly and cost-efficient Tata Tiago EV. We'll set off on an exhilarating coastal journey, with golden beaches, swaying palm trees, and crystal-clear waters as our backdrop.
